artifactType: Unexecuted local adapter for final-context native D preparation, validation, synthesis and owner planning
scopeBoundary: The65 existing field-science records are the measured preliminary roster. Root must supply the final post-apply applicability measurement and exact final roster; neither65 nor any preliminary canonical digest is embedded as an executable acceptance default.

historicalActualMaterializationPattern.usedAs: API/command/provenance reference only; no old private capsule or absolute /mnt/e execution path is used by the adapter

actualContractFindings.prepare: prepareGoalDescriptionRolloutBatch uses stock goal-book loader, bounded subset model, HTML/PDF renderer, review bundle export and two stock createGoalDescriptionReviewCampaignArtifacts calls. No code from this pipeline is replaced.
actualContractFindings.boundedSize: Native standalone config/index allows1..20 goals per group.65 would require at least4 groups; final count is supplied after the final Root measurement.
actualContractFindings.blindPolicy: Stock dual-round validation requires two distinct first_pass campaigns, distinct independence groups, blindToOtherReviews=true and non-synthesizer run.blindToOtherRuns=true. Campaign template booleans are not evidence that a reviewer actually obeyed the policy.
actualContractFindings.reviewMode: There is no reviewMode property in the native record or dual-resolution schemas; additionalProperties=false forbids adding one. The adapter accepts reviewMode only in an external actual reviewer receipt, never in a native record. Informed historical followups are preserved as science and are not relabelled as fresh blind final-input runs.
actualContractFindings.currentContextBinding: Resolution validation requires both source rounds to match the exact current V3 per-goal review-context fingerprint. Goal text, page, positive evidence context and canonical context must bind the final inputs. Earlier source/edge/D judgments do not by themselves satisfy this new native-page binding.
actualContractFindings.actualPeerActionRemaining: Two genuinely completed stock-conformant reviews of each changed final input/page/context are needed before strict native resolution. Existing paired subject-matter science is retained and need not be independently restarted merely because of this preparation. If only informed followups with blind=false are supplied, this unchanged stock dual-resolution path cannot accept them; the adapter refuses rather than manufacturing blind flags or schemas.
actualContractFindings.PDFBoundary: Stock prepare necessarily renders a bounded PDF; current task performs no render. A later explicit --execute --phase prepare additionally requires --allow-bounded-pdf. PDF-free final native prepare is not available in the existing stock contract.
actualContractFindings.recordOwnership: New standalone indices contribute current rows. Keep every old index registered; append one supersession edge from the actual existing terminal owner to the new owner. Do not branch from an earlier historical node. New04eb/31c/abfa have no previous native owner in the65 measurement.
actualContractFindings.chainValidation: ownership-plan calls stock validateResolutionSemanticRetirements/buildResolutionSupersessionChains and validates each new index through materializeGoalDescriptionRolloutBatchResolutionIndex(config,false). It never activates registry fields.
actualContractFindings.scopeNarrowingCompatibility: The separately existing scope-narrowing compatibility validator is diagnostic only and is not a dual-round resolution, so it cannot serve as a blanket substitute for the new native D binding.
